text:
priya: Quick sync to lock alpha gate for the Optimize Advisor (batching, prefix cache, quant recs, eval alerts). Need a clear pilot acceptance definition for customers.
sam: Alpha proposal: read-only in-console recs + eval alerts to a webhook + per-route opt-out flag. GA adds apply-button, auto-rollout, and exportable rulebook.
anna: We must clarify data retention for eval traces. Customers ask for 90d or 180d. Can we make retention configurable per account?
kai: Engineering notes: we'll ship a trace sampler (1% or capped at 10k events/day), a cache simulator, and a quant-sim that reports confidence and delta_estimate. Alpha uses sampled traces only.
jordan: SRE: define tolerated latency uplift when batching is applied. For alpha, recs should be advisory only; fallback policy required for any auto-apply later. Recommend p95 uplift limit = +12% for auto-apply.
priya: Draft acceptance criteria:
```
- Console surfaces per-route recs for batching/caching/quant with a short rationale
- Eval alerts delivered to webhook, debounced (see policy below)
- Route-level opt-out flag respected (`tuning_advisor: disabled`)
- Telemetry: batch_size_avg, cache_hit_rate, quant_confidence emitted
```
sam: Debounce policy suggestion: alert after 4 failing evals in 24h OR rolling metric delta > 2 sigma. Include human-readable "why" in payload.
anna: Docs must include quick rollback CLI example:
```
# revert quant / advisor on route
redwood routes patch my-route --metadata '{"tuning_advisor":"disabled"}'
```
kai: Perf test plan: run three workload profiles (chat_short, doc_long, streaming) across fp16/int8 sims; capture p50, p95, p99 and eval regression delta.
priya: Pilot timeline: 14-day alpha with 3 customers, then 14-day beta. Sign-off at end of alpha requires no high-severity quality regressions and either cache_hit_rate >= 20% on recommended routes or a mitigation plan.
sam: I'll recruit BetaCo and DataLabs; Acme is a maybe. Need a support rota.
priya: Action items: kai: trace sampler + quant-sim prototype (4d), anna: pilot docs + runbook (5d), jordan: SLO uplift thresholds + fallback runbook (4d), sam: confirm pilot customers (2d). Reconvene in 48h for status. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy note: branch optimize-advisor/alpha -> staged; e2e queued :gear:
